rules:
VERDICT RULES - fixed before the anchor numbers were read

For channel c on anchor A over the N subjects having both the anchor movement and the
Exercise B reference movement 11:

  coherence(c,A) = fraction of subjects where delta_raw and delta_angle share a sign
  agreement(c,A) = fraction of subjects where delta_angle has the sign REQUIRED by the
                   official DB9 sign criteria
  opposed(c,A)   = fraction where delta_angle has the opposite sign
  mag_ratio(c,A) = |median delta_raw(c)| / median over the responsive flexion channels of
                   |median delta_raw| on the same anchor

  CASE_C_PREVIOUS_QC_WRONG        agreement >= 0.80
  CASE_A_RELEASED_REPRESENTATION  coherence >= 0.80 AND opposed >= 0.80
  CASE_B_SENSOR_OR_FIT_LIMIT      mag_ratio < 0.15 OR coherence < 0.60
  CASE_D_DOCUMENTATION_CONFLICT   released constant differs from the published table
  CASE_E_INCONCLUSIVE             otherwise

  KEEP          <- CASE_C
  DROP          <- CASE_A, CASE_B, official exclusion
  INCONCLUSIVE  <- CASE_D, CASE_E, no anchor

CMC1_f.reason: no pre-declared physical anchor in Exercise B for this channel

CMC1_a.reason: no pre-declared physical anchor in Exercise B for this channel

MCP2_a.reason: Ninapro usage notes: 'Sensor 11 (which corresponds to MCP2-3_A) was not included into the calibrated data due to noise problems.'  The released angles[:,5] column is all NaN.

PIP3.reason: PIP3 responds to a fist in only 20 of 37 subjects, with a raw magnitude 8 % of the flexion-channel median; its raw and released-angle behaviour are mutually consistent, but the physical anchor is not reproduced.

MCP4_a.released_vs_published: released polynomial coefficients [0.22906, -0.07517, 0.05592, 0.00623, 0.00711, -0.01324] vs published [0.229, -0.169, 0.006, 0.167, 0.007, -0.013]; the gauge column and the two adjacent MCP-flexion columns match, but three of the six coefficients differ by more than 2 %
MCP4_a.reason: released MCP4_a and the raw abduction gauge move in OPPOSITE directions in 37 of 37 subjects on the abduction anchor, and three of its six published polynomial coefficients are not reproduced in the release.

PIP4.reason: responds to a fist in 28 of 37 subjects.

CMC5.reason: the released CMC5 column is an exact linear function (slope 0.28511, matching the published 0.285) of the SAME raw column that feeds WRIST_F.  In the wrist flexion anchor both move by exactly the same raw amount (+9.96 counts, 37/37); in the wrist extension anchor both move by -19.41 counts (37/37).  One raw sensor cannot be both the palmar arch and the wrist.  In the fist anchor CMC5 does not move at all (19/18).

MCP5_a.released_vs_published: the released polynomial is not reproduced from the published coefficients (residual 44 deg peak-to-peak)
MCP5_a.reason: the released polynomial is not reproduced from the published coefficients.

DIP2.reason: responds in the CORRECT direction (28 of 37), unlike DIP3/DIP4/DIP5.

DIP3.reason: on an unambiguous fist (Exercise B movements 6 and 17) the raw DIP3 gauge DECREASES in 35 of 37 subjects and the released DIP3 angle decreases with it, while in the very same segments every MCP and PIP flexion channel increases. The transform is faithful; the direction contradicts the official 'DIP(2-5)_F Flexion+/Extension-' criterion.

DIP4.released_vs_published: released constant 2.0 vs published 2.08 (3.8 % difference, above the 2 % materiality threshold)
DIP4.reason: the same inversion, but coherent in only 28 of 37 subjects and with a raw response 11 % of the flexion-channel median.

DIP5.reason: the same inversion, coherent in 32 of 37 subjects, raw response 11 % of the flexion-channel median.

WRIST_F.released_vs_published: released constant 0.00865779 vs published 0.008 (8.2 % difference, above the 2 % materiality threshold)
WRIST_F.reason: the wrist-flexion and wrist-extension anchors both pass at 37/37, so the channel's physical behaviour is sound; the only defect is that its released quadratic coefficient differs from the published one.

hand_size.verdict: HAND_SIZE_HYPOTHESIS_NOT_TESTABLE_FROM_RELEASED_METADATA - the released subject table carries sex, handedness, age, height and weight only; no hand length or width is published.  Height is used as the only available substitute and sex as an explicitly labelled exploratory secondary proxy.
hand_size.note: A correlation found here classifies the failure; it is never used to repair, rescale or re-sign any channel.

sensor11.verdict: NO IMPACT - the released DB9 angle column 5 (MCP2_a) is all NaN and no historical representation of this project selects it; canonical16 is built from the emg2pose 20D array and never from a DB9 angle column.
sensor11.released_status: angles[:,5] is all NaN in every released file; glove[:,5] still carries the raw noisy gauge
